# Claude Code MCP

MCP is the Model Context Protocol, an open standard that lets Claude Code use tools, files, and prompts from other programs.
A program that offers them is an MCP server.
For example, `claude mcp add --transport http notion https://mcp.notion.com/mcp` adds a server over HTTP.

## Marks

| Mark | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| ✅ | A page of the [Claude Code docs](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/overview) names it. |
| 🔍 | Only the Claude Code bundle names it. No docs page does. |
| ⚠️ | The docs and the bundle differ. The row says how. |
| 🧪 | It works only behind a flag, a plan, or a server-side switch. The row says which. |
| ❌ | It is removed or does nothing in `2.1.303`. |

## Transports

| Mark | Item | What It Does | How It Works | Where It Can Be Used | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ✅ | `stdio` | Runs a local process | Default when `type` is absent. Needs `command`. Claude Code sets `CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR` in the process env | Every scope, plugins, agent files | [Connect Claude Code to Tools via MCP](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/mcp), [Control MCP Server Access for Your Organization](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/managed-mcp) |
| ✅ | `http` | Remote server over streamable HTTP | The recommended remote transport. `streamable-http` is an alias. Supports OAuth and `headers` | Every scope, plugins, agent files | [Connect Claude Code to Tools via MCP](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/mcp), [Control MCP Server Access for Your Organization](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/managed-mcp) |
| ✅ | `sse` | Remote server over SSE | Deprecated. `--transport http` tries HTTP first and falls back to SSE (`2.1.265` and later) | Every scope, plugins, agent files | [Connect Claude Code to Tools via MCP](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/mcp), [Control MCP Server Access for Your Organization](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/managed-mcp) |
| ✅ | `ws` | Remote server over WebSocket | Header-only auth. No OAuth. `claude mcp add --transport` does not accept it. First connect is not retried | `.mcp.json`, `add-json`, plugins, agent files | [Connect Claude Code to Tools via MCP](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/mcp) |
| ✅ | `sdk` | In-process server of an SDK host | Only an SDK host can register it. Claude Code skips it in `.mcp.json` and settings | SDK `mcpServers`, `mcp_set_servers` | [Connect Claude Code to Tools via MCP](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/mcp), [Control MCP Server Access for Your Organization](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/managed-mcp) |
| 🔍 | `sse-ide` | Server of an IDE extension over SSE | Has `ideName` and `ideRunningInWindows`. The idle timeout does not apply | IDE integration | Bundle: server schema `sse-ide` |
| 🔍 | `ws-ide` | Server of an IDE extension over WebSocket | Has `ideName`, `authToken`, and `ideRunningInWindows` | IDE integration | Bundle: server schema `ws-ide` |
| 🔍 | `claudeai-proxy` | A claude.ai connector through the MCP proxy | A config file cannot declare it. Claude Code reports `type "claudeai-proxy" is used only by claude.ai connectors` | Scope `claudeai` | Bundle: server schema `claudeai-proxy` |

## Scopes

| Mark | Item | What It Does | How It Works | Where It Can Be Used | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ✅ | `local` | Private server for one project | Default scope. Stored in `~/.claude.json` under `projects["<path>"].mcpServers` | `claude mcp add` | [Connect Claude Code to Tools via MCP](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/mcp), [CLI Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/cli-reference) |
| ✅ | `project` | Server shared with the team | Stored in `.mcp.json` at the project root. Needs approval in interactive sessions | `claude mcp add --scope project` | [Connect Claude Code to Tools via MCP](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/mcp), [CLI Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/cli-reference) |
| ✅ | `user` | Server for all your projects | Stored in `~/.claude.json` under `mcpServers` | `claude mcp add --scope user` | [Connect Claude Code to Tools via MCP](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/mcp), [CLI Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/cli-reference) |
| ✅ | Plugin | Servers that a plugin bundles | Named `plugin:<plugin>:<server>`. Tools are `mcp__plugin_<plugin>_<server>__<tool>` | `.mcp.json` in the plugin root or `mcpServers` in `plugin.json` | MCP docs, Plugin-provided MCP servers |
| ✅ | claude.ai connectors | Servers added in claude.ai | Fetched at start for a claude.ai login. Lowest precedence | `/mcp`, scope `claudeai` | MCP docs, Use MCP servers from claude.ai |
| ✅ | `managed` | Servers that the organization provides | `managedMcpServers` setting or `managed-mcp.json`. Ranks above all other sources (`2.1.259` and later) | Managed settings | [Connect Claude Code to Tools via MCP](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/mcp) |
| 🔍 | `dynamic` | Servers passed at run time | The bundle uses it for `--mcp-config` and for the remote copy from `CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE_MCP_CONFIG` | `--mcp-config`, SDK | Bundle: scope list |
| 🔍 | `enterprise`, `agent` | Other scope names in the bundle list | The scope list is `local`, `user`, `project`, `dynamic`, `enterprise`, `claudeai`, `managed`, `agent` | Unknown | Bundle: scope list |
